comments.author: Nina
comments.body: Pricing on these kinds of items depends entirely on TBox drop rate. What it's worth right now is different than what it will be worth in 2 weeks is different than what it will be worth in 3 months. Mysterious compass was worth 50M plus before it came out in tbox, by time it was over i bought 3 for 5 mil each and could have bought more. Maybe price goes back up or maybe market is so flooded that's all they'll be worth for a year.

comments.author: Chester
comments.body:
I've seen many of these for 50m lately. I'm the same guy from earlier who paid 200m, but when I wanted one was when they were new. I found a guy shouting about one, I offered 100m and he promptly ignored me, so next guy I found shouting I offered 200m and he seemed overly excited to get one. Prices really are a question of where the buyer and the seller are willing to meet, and the parties involved change every time.

Also, as far as these things going up in value, I kind of doubt they'll raise all that much, barring the massive inflation some predict with El Oriente. While there's way more alchemists around these days than there used to be, alchemy's still not the easiest skill to get.
